items.stem: Which TWO statements about client-side storage are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: IndexedDB suits larger, structured client-side data
options.rationale: Correct: IndexedDB is designed for larger structured records.

options.text: localStorage is best for small key/value preferences
options.rationale: Correct: localStorage holds small string key/value data.

options.text: Cookies are ideal for storing megabytes of data
options.rationale: Cookies are tiny and sent with every request.

options.text: The URL hash should hold all application data
options.rationale: The URL is not a general data store.

items.explanation: Correct: IndexedDB is designed for larger structured records.

options.text: It is readable by any script and exposed to XSS

options.text: It is too small to hold a token
options.rationale: Size is not the main concern.
